name: phase11_position_v1

target_new.domain: wiki prose filler (same corpus as reference)

split.note: position coefficients fit ONLY on fit_positions; test_positions never seen during fitting (zero-refit)

model_defs.base_log: P = sigma(a + b*log(1+D)); (a,b) frozen from reference
model_defs.pos_edge: base_log + c*|2P-1|; (a,b) frozen, c fit on fit-split
model_defs.pos_quad: base_log + c*(2P-1)^2; (a,b) frozen, c fit on fit-split

primary_comparison: base_log vs pos-aware models on held-out positions
primary_test: does position explain residual error after D, S, L are known?
protocol: calibrate base on position=0.5 reference -> freeze -> evaluate position extension held-out (zero-refit on test positions)

outcome_interpretation.A: position adds information (|Spearman| >= 0.8 on held-out positions AND pos-aware beats base by >= 0.03 MAE)
outcome_interpretation.B: position ranks cells but does not improve calibration (|Spearman| >= 0.8, MAE gain < 0.03)
outcome_interpretation.C: position redundant (fails to beat base and |Spearman| < 0.8)

honesty_notes: position = evidence (needle) position only; decoy positions independently randomized per seed, controlled as random noise
position coefficients fit only on fit-split; test positions never seen during fitting (true zero-refit on position)
filler token count exact (same corpus); needle passage length identical across positions
